english.title: Give false information / document in response to Treasury request for information
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been requested by the Treasury for information under regulation 26 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021, knowingly or recklessly,

(A)_[gave information]_
(B)_[produced a document,]_

which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY FALSE INFORMATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28(1)(b) and 31(3)(a) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly / recklessly
gave information / produced any document
that was false in a material particular
in response to a request to provide information
made by the Treasury under regulation 26 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Where a person is convicted for this offence, the court can make an order requiring the person to comply with the request within a specified period, see regulation 28(2) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.
